questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about introductory concepts. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: Which allocation matches the official SAA-C03 scored-content domains?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Security 30%, Resilience 26%, Performance 24%, Cost Optimization 20%.
questions.technical_resolution: The exam guide assigns these four weights to scored content. A community practice set need not have the same distribution.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: A team runs its application on EC2 instances. Under the shared responsibility model, who patches the guest operating system?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: The customer operating the EC2 instances.
questions.technical_resolution: For EC2, AWS manages the underlying infrastructure; the customer manages the guest OS, applications, and their configuration. Automation can help the customer perform that responsibility.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A workload must recover a document that a user accidentally overwrote yesterday. Which capability directly addresses that requirement?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Retain previous object versions and test how to restore the required version.
questions.technical_resolution: S3 Versioning retains earlier versions so an overwrite can be reversed. Redundant compute and DNS do not retain earlier application data.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: A business can tolerate losing at most 15 minutes of data and needs service restored within 2 hours. Which objectives express these requirements?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: RPO of 15 minutes and RTO of 2 hours.
questions.technical_resolution: RPO limits acceptable data loss measured in time; RTO limits acceptable recovery time. Managed services do not remove the need to define or test those objectives.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: A design requires AWS API access from an EC2 application without distributing long-lived access keys. Which proposal satisfies the security requirement?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Attach an appropriately scoped IAM role to the instance through an instance profile.
questions.technical_resolution: An EC2 workload can obtain temporary credentials from its IAM role. Permissions should cover only the application actions and resources it needs.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about IAM and security. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: An EC2 application needs to read objects only from one S3 prefix. What is the recommended credential and permission design?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: An instance role with temporary credentials and s3:GetObject scoped to the required object prefix.
questions.technical_resolution: Roles avoid distributing long-lived keys. The object ARN scope and permitted action must match the required prefix; a role name alone grants nothing.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: An identity policy allows an S3 action, but an applicable bucket policy explicitly denies that same request. What is the authorization result?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: The request is denied.
questions.technical_resolution: An applicable explicit deny overrides an allow for the same request. Policy creation time does not determine authorization precedence.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A member account has an SCP that allows S3 actions, but a new IAM role has no identity or resource policy granting S3 access. What does the SCP provide?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: A permissions ceiling; the role still needs an applicable permission grant.
questions.technical_resolution: SCPs limit permissions in member accounts and do not grant access. Applicable identity or resource policies must grant the action within those limits.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: Employees need centrally managed sign-in to several AWS accounts with short-lived sessions. Which approach best fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Use IAM Identity Center with account assignments and permission sets.
questions.technical_resolution: IAM Identity Center supports centralized workforce access to AWS accounts. Permission sets define the account permissions available through the assigned sessions.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: A production role has broader permissions than its observed workload requires. Which improvement follows AWS least-privilege guidance?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Review access activity, generate and validate a scoped policy, test required operations, and remove unused permissions.
questions.technical_resolution: Access analysis and testing help reduce permissions while preserving required behavior. Observed activity is evidence, but infrequent legitimate operations must also be considered.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about EC2. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: A batch job checkpoints its progress and can resume after interruption. It has a flexible completion window. Which EC2 purchase option is designed for spare capacity at a discount?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Spot Instances.
questions.technical_resolution: Spot uses spare EC2 capacity and can be interrupted. Checkpointing and flexible scheduling make the stated batch workload a suitable candidate, subject to capacity availability.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: An EC2 instance is in one Availability Zone and an EBS volume is in another. How can the data be made available as an attachable EBS volume to that instance?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Create a snapshot and create a new volume from it in the instance Availability Zone.
questions.technical_resolution: An EBS volume attaches to instances in its own Availability Zone. A snapshot can be used to create a volume in another Availability Zone in the Region.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: Linux EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones need concurrent access to the same managed NFS file system. Which choice fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Amazon EFS Regional with mount targets and suitable security group rules.
questions.technical_resolution: EFS provides managed shared NFS storage; the Regional storage option supports a multi-AZ design. Mount targets and network access still need configuration.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: Tightly coupled EC2 workers need low-latency communication inside one Availability Zone. Which common placement strategy targets this requirement?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: A cluster placement group.
questions.technical_resolution: A cluster placement group places supported instances close together in one AZ for tightly coupled workloads. This is a performance choice, not protection from losing that AZ.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: A team buys a Compute Savings Plan for its steady baseline. Which statement is accurate?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: It discounts eligible usage in exchange for a spend commitment; it does not by itself reserve EC2 capacity.
questions.technical_resolution: Savings Plans are pricing commitments. Capacity reservations are a separate design consideration, and unused commitment can reduce realized savings.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about high availability. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: A stateless HTTP application must tolerate an AZ outage. Which design addresses that failure scope?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: An ALB and an Auto Scaling group spanning at least two AZs, with enough surviving capacity and externalized application state.
questions.technical_resolution: Distributing compute and load balancing across AZs reduces dependence on one AZ. Surviving capacity, health checks, and state placement must also support the application during failure.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: One HTTPS entry point must route /images to one target group and /orders to another. Which load balancer provides this request-path routing?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Application Load Balancer.
questions.technical_resolution: ALB evaluates application-layer listener rules, including path conditions. The other choices do not provide HTTP path-based target-group routing.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: An Auto Scaling instance passes EC2 status checks, but its application fails ALB health checks. Which configuration lets the group use those application health results to replace it?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Enable Elastic Load Balancing health checks for the group and configure an appropriate grace period.
questions.technical_resolution: The group must be configured to use ELB health checks in addition to its default EC2 checks. A suitable grace period avoids replacing instances merely because startup is still in progress.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: HTTP traffic varies unpredictably. The team wants the instance count to follow a utilization metric around a chosen target. Which policy fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Target tracking scaling with a suitable metric and instance warmup configuration.
questions.technical_resolution: Target tracking changes capacity to keep a supported metric near its target. Scheduled changes can complement it for known events, but cannot alone react to unpredictable demand.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: Users lose shopping carts when an application instance is replaced. Carts exist only in that instance memory. Which change addresses the data-placement problem?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Store cart state in an appropriate shared data store and make web instances replaceable.
questions.technical_resolution: External state storage lets a replacement instance retrieve the cart, subject to the store consistency and durability design. Routing a user to one instance does not persist that instance memory.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about S3. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: An S3 bucket must retain earlier object contents when an application overwrites an existing key. Which feature directly provides that history?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: S3 Versioning.
questions.technical_resolution: Versioning retains multiple versions of an object key. A lifecycle policy may be needed to control noncurrent-version storage costs, and permanent version deletion still needs protection.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: Records require a fixed WORM retention period that must not be shortened or bypassed by users, including the account root user. Which S3 feature and mode fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: S3 Object Lock in compliance mode with the required retention period.
questions.technical_resolution: Compliance-mode retention prevents protected versions from being overwritten or deleted during the retention period, including by root. Plan carefully because a test record can remain retained until expiry.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A dataset is the only copy of irreplaceable records and must survive loss of an AZ. Which choice is unsuitable as its sole storage location?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: S3 One Zone-IA.
questions.technical_resolution: One Zone-IA stores data in one AZ and is not resilient to physical loss of that AZ. It suits reproducible data or appropriate secondary copies, not this sole-copy requirement.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: A private application bucket must reject accidental public grants through bucket policies or ACLs. Which S3 control is specifically designed for that purpose?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: S3 Block Public Access configured at the applicable account and bucket levels.
questions.technical_resolution: Block Public Access prevents public access according to its settings. It complements authenticated IAM access and does not replace least-privilege authorization.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: A retained dataset is rarely read, but every retrieval must begin immediately without a restore job. Which storage decision follows the requirement?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Choose a suitable immediate-access class, such as S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval, after checking retrieval and minimum-duration charges.
questions.technical_resolution: Glacier Instant Retrieval provides immediate access, whereas Flexible Retrieval and Deep Archive use restore workflows. Storage, request, retrieval, and minimum-duration costs all affect the choice.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about VPC. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: EC2 workloads in a VPC need same-Region S3 access without using an internet gateway or a NAT gateway. Which endpoint type can be added to the relevant route tables?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: An S3 gateway VPC endpoint.
questions.technical_resolution: An S3 gateway endpoint provides a route-based private path to supported S3 destinations. Bucket, endpoint, and IAM policies still need to permit the requests.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: A security group permits an EC2 instance to initiate an outbound TCP connection. What is its behavior for response traffic belonging to that connection?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: It allows the response traffic through connection tracking, subject to the documented tracking behavior.
questions.technical_resolution: Security groups are stateful. Network ACLs and routes remain separate requirements; the security group does not replace either.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A custom network ACL allows inbound HTTPS to an instance but denies all outbound traffic. Why can a client connection still fail?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: The stateless ACL must also allow the required outbound return traffic, including client ephemeral ports.
questions.technical_resolution: Network ACLs evaluate inbound and outbound packets independently. Required return traffic must match an outbound allow rule before a deny rule.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: A subnet route table points to an internet gateway. An EC2 instance has only a private IPv4 address. Which statement is correct for direct IPv4 internet connectivity?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: The route makes the subnet public, but the instance also needs a public IPv4 address or Elastic IP and appropriate network rules for direct internet communication.
questions.technical_resolution: Public-subnet routing and public addressing are separate requirements. Security groups and network ACLs must also allow the intended traffic.

questions.topic: Outbound NAT does not grant inbound access
questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: Private IPv4 instances need to initiate connections to public software repositories, while unsolicited inbound internet connections must remain unavailable. Which design fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Use an appropriately routed public NAT gateway and keep the instances without public IPv4 addresses.
questions.technical_resolution: A public NAT gateway supports outbound-initiated IPv4 internet connectivity for private instances. It does not accept unsolicited inbound connections to them; routing and firewall rules still matter.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about databases. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: An RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment has one primary and one synchronous standby. Which statement about that standby is correct?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: It supports managed failover and does not serve application read traffic.
questions.technical_resolution: The standby in a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment is for availability. This must not be generalized to Multi-AZ DB clusters, whose reader instances can serve reads.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: A team selects an RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment with a writer and two readable instances in separate AZs. How can those instances be used?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: They support failover and can serve read traffic through the appropriate endpoints.
questions.technical_resolution: RDS distinguishes Multi-AZ DB clusters from Multi-AZ DB instance deployments. The cluster has one writer and readable failover candidates distributed across three AZs in one Region.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: Reports are directed to an ordinary asynchronous RDS DB instance read replica. Can an application assume every successful write to the primary is immediately visible there?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: No. Replication lag can make the replica temporarily stale.
questions.technical_resolution: Asynchronous read replicas are useful for read scaling, but the application must tolerate lag. Read-after-write requirements may require a different read path.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: A DynamoDB application requires strongly consistent reads immediately after a successful write. Which read path supports that consistency option?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Read the base table with ConsistentRead enabled, rather than using a GSI for this read.
questions.technical_resolution: DynamoDB supports strongly consistent reads on tables and local secondary indexes. Global secondary index reads are eventually consistent; that restriction is distinct from global-table consistency modes.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: A review claims that every DynamoDB global table is necessarily eventually consistent across Regions. What is the accurate correction?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Global tables offer multi-Region eventual consistency and multi-Region strong consistency modes; check the selected mode and supported configuration.
questions.technical_resolution: The current documentation distinguishes MREC and MRSC. Availability, topology, and feature constraints must be checked before choosing a mode; neither blanket consistency claim is correct.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about Route 53 and CloudFront. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: A new CloudFront distribution serves a regular private S3 bucket origin. The bucket must stay private while CloudFront can read objects. Which design is recommended?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Configure OAC, signed origin requests, and a bucket policy restricted to the intended CloudFront distribution.
questions.technical_resolution: Origin access control authorizes CloudFront access to a regular S3 origin. The bucket policy must allow the intended distribution. Website endpoints are custom origins and do not support OAC.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: An application has equivalent endpoints in multiple AWS Regions. DNS responses should favor the Region offering the best latency to the user. Which Route 53 policy fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Latency-based routing.
questions.technical_resolution: Latency-based routing selects among configured regional resources using latency information. It does not promise the geographically nearest location or a fixed split of requests.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A team wants DNS responses distributed between old and new regional endpoints in configured relative proportions. Which Route 53 policy is intended for this?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Weighted routing.
questions.technical_resolution: Weighted records support relative response proportions. DNS caching and resolver behavior mean the observed application-request split is not an exact per-request percentage guarantee.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: A globally used UDP application needs static anycast entry IPs and routing across the AWS network to healthy regional endpoints. Which service fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: AWS Global Accelerator with supported endpoints.
questions.technical_resolution: Global Accelerator supports TCP and UDP applications with static anycast IP addresses and regional endpoint routing. CloudFront is an HTTP(S) content delivery service, not an arbitrary UDP proxy.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: An HTTP application behind an ALB needs managed rule-based filtering for common web exploits. Which service is designed for that application-layer filtering?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: AWS WAF associated with the supported application resource.
questions.technical_resolution: AWS WAF evaluates web requests with rules and can protect supported resources such as an ALB. Its rules complement, rather than replace, secure application design and network controls.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about decoupling. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: An order worker uses an SQS Standard queue. A message can be delivered again after a retry. Which application design addresses duplicate side effects?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Use an idempotency key and an atomic or otherwise safe duplicate-detection operation before committing the order side effect.
questions.technical_resolution: Standard queues provide at-least-once delivery. The business operation must safely handle repeated delivery; successful processing and message acknowledgement are separate steps.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: Updates for each customer must remain ordered, while different customers can process in parallel. Which SQS FIFO design matches that requirement?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Use the customer identifier as MessageGroupId and appropriate deduplication identifiers.
questions.technical_resolution: FIFO ordering is scoped to a message group. Separate customer groups allow independent processing while preserving each group order.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A producer retries an SQS FIFO SendMessage call with the same deduplication ID within the deduplication interval. Which conclusion is justified?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: SQS suppresses duplicate sends in that interval, but the application must still handle retried processing safely.
questions.technical_resolution: FIFO send deduplication operates within a documented five-minute interval. It is not an unlimited transaction guarantee for downstream business effects or failed consumer processing.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: Billing and shipping must each receive every order event and process independently with durable buffering. Which design fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: An SNS topic with a separate subscribed SQS queue for each consumer, with appropriate queue access policies.
questions.technical_resolution: SNS fan-out can place an event on each subscribed queue. Separate queues preserve independent buffering and retry behavior; duplicates still require safe consumer design.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: Order fulfillment needs an explicit sequence of tasks, branching, retries, and a human approval callback. Which service is designed to orchestrate such a workflow?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: An appropriate AWS Step Functions Standard workflow.
questions.technical_resolution: Step Functions models workflow state and task transitions, with supported callback integrations for Standard workflows. An event router can start a workflow but is not itself the full orchestrator.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about Containers. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: A team chooses ECS for long-running containers and does not want to provision or patch EC2 worker hosts. Which compute option fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: AWS Fargate for the ECS tasks.
questions.technical_resolution: Fargate supplies managed container compute. The team still configures task resources, images, permissions, networking, and service scaling.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: Application code inside an ECS task calls S3. Which role should carry the application S3 permissions?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: The ECS task IAM role.
questions.technical_resolution: The task role supplies permissions to code running in containers. The task execution role serves agent operations such as pulling images and shipping configured logs.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A Fargate task needs its agent to pull a private ECR image and send logs with the awslogs driver. Which role is relevant to those agent operations?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: The task execution IAM role with the necessary permissions.
questions.technical_resolution: The execution role authorizes supported ECS/Fargate agent operations. Application API permissions remain separate in the task role.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: A workload explicitly requires Kubernetes APIs and Kubernetes-native controllers. Which AWS managed orchestration service matches that requirement?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Amazon EKS.
questions.technical_resolution: EKS provides a managed Kubernetes control plane. Compute, access, add-ons, networking, and workload configuration still need an appropriate operating model.

questions.topic: Fargate does not choose task demand
questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: An ECS service on Fargate must increase its desired task count as load rises. What is still required?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Configure an appropriate ECS service scaling policy and limits; Fargate alone does not choose the service desired count from application demand.
questions.technical_resolution: Fargate manages the underlying task compute. Application Auto Scaling policies determine desired-count changes for an ECS service, subject to configured limits and available capacity.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about Serverless. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: A Lambda application must retain customer workflow state across retries and new execution environments. Where should that durable state live?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: In an appropriate external durable store, such as DynamoDB, with a suitable consistency and idempotency design.
questions.technical_resolution: Execution environment reuse can improve performance, but it is not a durability guarantee. Customer workflow state must survive environment replacement and concurrent invocations.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: A team wants to limit a Lambda function concurrency so it cannot overwhelm a database. Which control directly sets a function concurrency ceiling?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Reserved concurrency.
questions.technical_resolution: Reserved concurrency reserves an allocation and caps that function concurrent execution. Provisioned concurrency pre-initializes environments to reduce cold-start latency and is a different control.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A latency-sensitive Lambda function needs pre-initialized execution environments and accepts their additional cost. Which feature is designed for that requirement?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Provisioned concurrency on a supported function version or alias.
questions.technical_resolution: Provisioned concurrency keeps a configured number of environments initialized. Capacity planning and limits still matter; it is not a promise of zero latency for all traffic.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: A Lambda SQS batch contains several successful records and one failed record. How can the consumer avoid needlessly retrying the successful records?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Enable and implement partial batch responses, returning the failed item identifiers while making processing idempotent.
questions.technical_resolution: Partial batch responses let a configured event source mapping retry the failed records. At-least-once processing still requires safe handling of duplicates.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: A public API Gateway REST API uses usage-plan API keys. The team must authenticate users and authorize protected operations. What additional design is required?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Use a supported authorization mechanism, such as an appropriate authorizer or IAM authorization; treat API keys as usage-plan identifiers.
questions.technical_resolution: API Gateway usage-plan keys support identification for usage control, not authentication or authorization. Protected APIs need an explicit authorization design.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about Analytics. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: Athena queries frequently filter an S3 dataset by date and read only a few columns. Which change can reduce scanned data for on-demand queries?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Use a suitable date partition layout, columnar Parquet or ORC, compression, and queries that filter the partition keys.
questions.technical_resolution: Partition pruning and columnar formats can reduce data read. Partition granularity and file sizes must match the workload; excessive small files can hurt performance.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: A team needs a shared metadata catalog for tables stored in S3 and a separate transformation job. Which distinction is accurate?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: The Glue Data Catalog stores metadata; a Glue ETL job performs the configured transformation.
questions.technical_resolution: Catalog tables describe data and schemas. Crawlers can discover metadata; ETL jobs execute transformation logic. Metadata registration is not proof of transformed output.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: An application needs managed delivery of streaming records into S3 and can tolerate buffering before delivery. Which service directly matches?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Amazon Data Firehose.
questions.technical_resolution: Data Firehose buffers and delivers streaming records to supported destinations. Buffering and delivery behavior must be included in end-to-end latency planning.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: Several applications need to read a stream independently and reprocess retained records using their own consumer positions. Which service is designed for this model?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Kinesis Data Streams with suitable retention and consumer throughput configuration.
questions.technical_resolution: Kinesis Data Streams supports independent consumers reading retained records. Shard or capacity configuration, retention, partitioning, and consumer limits must fit the workload.

questions.topic: Do not use migration as analytics
questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: A team must transform and curate S3 data for analytics. Is an AWS DMS ongoing replication task alone proof that the required business ETL has been implemented?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: No. DMS replication and the required analytical transformations must be assessed separately; use an appropriate ETL design such as Glue jobs.
questions.technical_resolution: DMS moves data and supports migration-related capabilities; it is not a blanket substitute for arbitrary business ETL. Define the transformations and validate the curated results.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about ML and AI. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: Data scientists need managed tools to build, train, and deploy a custom machine learning model. Which service directly supports that lifecycle?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Amazon SageMaker AI.
questions.technical_resolution: SageMaker AI provides managed training and deployment capabilities. The team still owns dataset quality, model evaluation, permissions, and the suitability of the model for its use case.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: An application needs entity and sentiment analysis of supported text without first building a custom model. Which service fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Amazon Comprehend.
questions.technical_resolution: Comprehend offers pretrained natural-language analysis, including entities and sentiment. Supported languages, input types, and feature constraints must be checked for the specific operation.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A workflow must extract form fields and tables from scanned business documents using a managed document-analysis API. Which service fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Amazon Textract.
questions.technical_resolution: Textract supports document text, form, and table extraction. Validate extraction quality and route uncertain business-critical results for appropriate review.

questions.topic: Generative AI context without scope claims
questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: An optional generative AI exercise needs managed access to foundation models rather than building a model-serving fleet. Which service matches that capability?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Amazon Bedrock.
questions.technical_resolution: Bedrock provides managed foundation-model access. This is optional architecture context: the current SAA-C03 service list is non-exhaustive, and the repository must not claim a guaranteed exam question or weight for this topic.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: A team uses a managed model API for customer-facing decisions. Which operational responsibility remains with the team?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Evaluate output quality on representative data, protect inputs and outputs, and implement suitable handling for errors or unacceptable results.
questions.technical_resolution: Managed infrastructure does not establish that a model is appropriate for every business input. Application data handling, permissions, evaluation, and failure behavior remain part of the customer design.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about monitoring. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: An operations team needs a dashboard and alarm for an EC2 application latency metric. Which service directly provides metrics, dashboards, and alarms?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Amazon CloudWatch.
questions.technical_resolution: CloudWatch supports metrics, dashboards, logs, and alarms. The application must publish or instrument the relevant latency signal if it is not supplied automatically.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: Auditors need S3 GetObject activity for a selected bucket. The team has only the default CloudTrail event history view. What must be considered?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Configure appropriate S3 object data-event logging on a trail or event data store, including its cost and selection scope.
questions.technical_resolution: S3 object operations are CloudTrail data events. Trails and event data stores do not log data events by default; selectors must include the needed activity.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A team must determine how a supported security group configuration changed over time and evaluate it against configuration rules. Which service fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: AWS Config with the required recording and rules enabled.
questions.technical_resolution: Config records supported resource configuration history and evaluates configuration against rules. CloudTrail complements it with API activity, but serves a different primary question.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: A new distributed application needs tracing. Should the team treat the legacy X-Ray SDK and daemon as the preferred long-term instrumentation choice without reviewing support status?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: No. Review the maintenance notice and prefer an appropriate OpenTelemetry instrumentation and collection path.
questions.technical_resolution: AWS documents maintenance mode for the X-Ray SDKs and daemon starting February 25, 2026 and recommends OpenTelemetry migration. Distinguish instrumentation lifecycle from the availability of the X-Ray service.

questions.topic: Telemetry is not prevention by default
questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: A Config rule reports that a resource is noncompliant. No remediation or preventive policy is configured. Which statement is justified?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: The rule detects the condition; prevention or remediation requires an additional appropriate control.
questions.technical_resolution: Detection, prevention, and remediation are distinct capabilities. A configured rule evaluation is not proof that corrective action occurred or that all security requirements are met.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about migration. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: A heterogeneous relational database migration needs schema assessment and low-downtime data replication. Which plan accounts for both?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Assess and convert the schema using suitable DMS Schema Conversion or AWS SCT capabilities, then configure supported full-load and CDC replication with cutover validation.
questions.technical_resolution: DMS includes schema-conversion and data-migration capabilities, but support and conversion gaps depend on the source and target. Replication, application compatibility, and cutover must be validated separately.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: A team wants to rehost supported physical or virtual servers on AWS using continuous block-level replication. Which service is designed for this?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: AWS Transform MGN, formerly AWS Application Migration Service.
questions.technical_resolution: MGN replicates server blocks and supports test launches and cutover for rehosting. Rehosting is not the same as database-engine conversion or application refactoring.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: An organization has adequate network connectivity and must regularly copy files from a supported on-premises NFS share into S3 with integrity validation. Which service fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: AWS DataSync.
questions.technical_resolution: DataSync automates transfers between supported file or object storage systems and AWS storage. Source support, permissions, connectivity, and task settings still need verification.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: Partners must keep their existing SFTP clients while uploading files to managed AWS-backed storage. Which service directly provides an SFTP endpoint?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: AWS Transfer Family configured with a supported storage backend and authentication design.
questions.technical_resolution: Transfer Family provides managed file-transfer protocol endpoints, including SFTP. S3 storage is not itself an SFTP server, and DataSync serves a different transfer model.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: A new AWS customer in a commercial Region is planning a deployment on November 10, 2026. Should a new Snowball device order be assumed available?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: No. Snowball Edge is closed to new customers, and AWS has announced commercial-Region device support ending December 31, 2026; evaluate currently available transfer alternatives.
questions.technical_resolution: AWS service availability notices govern deployment eligibility. The exam scope list and historical offline-transfer patterns do not override customer or lifecycle restrictions.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about resilience and DR. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: Backups complete every 24 hours. A business requires at most 15 minutes of data loss. Can a fast restore alone prove this design meets the RPO?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: No. The recoverable data points must satisfy the 15-minute loss window; restore speed addresses RTO.
questions.technical_resolution: RPO describes acceptable data loss in time. The recovery data path needs sufficiently current valid recovery points; fast infrastructure restoration does not make old backups newer.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: A workload must recover after an entire AWS Region becomes unavailable. Does deploying the application and database across AZs only within that Region satisfy the failure scope by itself?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: No. A regional recovery design needs usable recovery resources and data outside the affected Region, plus tested recovery procedures.
questions.technical_resolution: Multi-AZ deployment addresses AZ-level failures within a Region. Regional recovery needs an appropriately independent recovery location and tested data, configuration, and traffic recovery.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A recovery Region maintains a small but fully functional copy of the application that can serve traffic before being scaled up. Which DR pattern best describes this?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Warm standby.
questions.technical_resolution: Warm standby maintains a scaled-down functioning workload. Pilot light keeps a smaller core running and requires additional activation or deployment before the full workload can serve.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: A team has a backup marked successful. What provides stronger evidence that business recovery objectives can be met?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Restore representative data in an isolated environment, validate the application, measure data loss and recovery duration, and compare them with RPO and RTO.
questions.technical_resolution: Recovery testing checks that data, dependencies, permissions, and procedures actually work together. A successful backup is necessary evidence for that copy, but not proof of end-to-end recovery.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: An accidental application command deletes valid records from a database whose changes replicate to its standby. What protection is additionally needed?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Retained backups or an appropriate point-in-time recovery capability, with tested restoration procedures.
questions.technical_resolution: Replication can reproduce logical mistakes as well as correct writes. Availability replicas do not replace retained recoverable history for corruption or accidental deletion.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about governance and costs. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: An SCP explicitly denies a service action in a member account. An IAM role there has AdministratorAccess. What happens to a request covered by the SCP deny?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: It is denied, unless the principal or action is within a documented SCP exemption.
questions.technical_resolution: An applicable SCP deny limits permissions in member accounts, including administrator roles. Management-account principals and some other entities have documented exceptions, which must not be generalized away.

questions.topic: Budget is not an instantaneous cap
questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: A lab account has an AWS Budgets notification at a chosen spend threshold. Does this guarantee that all charges stop exactly at that amount?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: No. Budget data and notifications are delayed; explicit controls, suitable actions, limits, and cleanup are still needed.
questions.technical_resolution: Budgets track costs and usage and can support configured actions. They are not a universal instantaneous hard spending cap; already-running resources and delayed cost data require careful operational controls.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A workload has a predictable long-running compute baseline plus uncertain bursts. Which cost approach avoids committing to the full possible peak?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Right-size from measured usage and evaluate an appropriate Savings Plan commitment for the stable baseline, leaving variable usage to suitable flexible capacity.
questions.technical_resolution: A commitment should match expected eligible usage and tolerance for underutilization. Bursts and interruption-sensitive work need a separate capacity and pricing decision.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: A team needs to inspect historical AWS costs by service and compare trends before choosing optimization actions. Which service fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: AWS Cost Explorer with appropriate filters and grouping.
questions.technical_resolution: Cost Explorer supports cost and usage analysis. Reliable allocation may require activated cost allocation tags or other account structure; analysis does not automatically implement every optimization.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: A team expects an SCP attached to the organization root to restrict IAM roles in the organization management account. What is the correction?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: SCPs do not restrict users or roles in the management account; protect that account with appropriate IAM controls and limited use.
questions.technical_resolution: AWS documents that SCPs do not affect management-account users or roles. Keep workloads and routine operations appropriately separated from highly privileged organization administration.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about hybrid connectivity. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: A design uses Direct Connect and must encrypt data in transit. Which statement is accurate?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Direct Connect is not encrypted by default; choose suitable TLS, IPsec VPN, or supported MACsec protection for the required path.
questions.technical_resolution: Private connectivity and encryption are separate properties. MACsec protects supported connection segments, so its coverage must be matched to the actual requirement rather than assumed end-to-end.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: VPC A is peered with VPC B, and B is peered with C. There is no A-to-C peering or transit service. Can A use B to reach C through those peerings?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: No. VPC peering does not support transitive routing.
questions.technical_resolution: A-to-B and B-to-C peerings do not create an A-to-C transit route. Use a supported connectivity design, such as suitable direct peerings or Transit Gateway attachments and routing.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: Many VPCs and on-premises networks need a managed hub-and-spoke connectivity design with centralized routing domains. Which service fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: AWS Transit Gateway with appropriate attachments and route tables.
questions.technical_resolution: Transit Gateway supplies a regional transit hub for supported attachments. Its route table associations, propagation, segmentation, and failure design still need explicit configuration.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: A provider wants to expose a supported application service privately to consumer VPCs without providing general network transit between the VPCs. Which pattern fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: AWS PrivateLink with a suitable endpoint service and consumer interface endpoints.
questions.technical_resolution: PrivateLink supports private connectivity to supported services through endpoints. It is service-oriented connectivity, not general-purpose transitive routing between all attached networks.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: A new design needs encrypted on-premises-to-VPC connectivity over existing internet access. Which service directly fits that transport model?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: AWS Site-to-Site VPN, with both provided tunnels and appropriate customer-side routing and redundancy.
questions.technical_resolution: Site-to-Site VPN provides IPsec connectivity. Using both tunnels and designing customer-device and path redundancy improves resilience; no single connection choice guarantees uninterrupted availability.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about encryption and secrets. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: An application must store a database credential and rotate that credential in both the secret store and the database. Which service directly provides this secret lifecycle capability?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: AWS Secrets Manager with a supported rotation integration or correctly configured rotation function.
questions.technical_resolution: Secrets Manager rotation updates the secret and the target service using a supported mechanism. KMS protects cryptographic keys and data; rotating KMS material does not change a database password.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: Automatic rotation changes the key material of a supported customer managed KMS key. What happens to existing data protected by that key?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: It is not automatically re-encrypted; KMS retains the material required to decrypt earlier ciphertext.
questions.technical_resolution: KMS rotation changes backing key material for future cryptographic operations. It does not rotate generated data keys or rewrite application data, and it is not secret credential rotation.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A regulated workload needs the customer to control a KMS key policy and its deletion lifecycle. Which key type fits?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: A customer managed KMS key.
questions.technical_resolution: Customer managed keys let customers manage key policies and lifecycle settings, subject to KMS controls. AWS owned keys are managed by the service and do not provide that customer policy control.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: A team needs versioned retrieval of a non-secret application configuration value. It does not require credential rotation. Which service is a suitable key-value configuration store?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Systems Manager Parameter Store.
questions.technical_resolution: Parameter Store supports centrally managed parameter values and versioning. SecureString adds KMS encryption when needed; secrets requiring purpose-built rotation should use an appropriate secrets service.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: An S3 object uses SSE-KMS. A policy also requires encrypted transport for clients. What additional transport requirement is appropriate?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Require HTTPS/TLS for the client connection and enforce the relevant access policy.
questions.technical_resolution: SSE-KMS protects object data at rest. TLS protects the network connection; authorization and transport enforcement are separate controls.

questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about Well-Architected. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: Which set names the six pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability.
questions.technical_resolution: The framework has six pillars. The four SAA-C03 scored-content domains are a different grouping and must not be mistaken for the complete framework.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: A team completes a workload review in AWS Well-Architected Tool. What does that establish?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: It records review findings and improvement opportunities; implementing and validating improvements remains the team responsibility.
questions.technical_resolution: The tool supports structured workload assessment and improvement planning. Review completion is not proof that every recommended change was implemented or tested.

questions.original_stem: To keep costs under control without losing technical quality, what should you do?
questions.stem: A proposal cuts cost by removing the only recovery copy of irreplaceable business data. The retention and recovery requirements have not changed. Is the proposal justified solely by lower storage cost?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: No. Cost optimization must still satisfy retention and recovery requirements.
questions.technical_resolution: The pillars must be considered together. Lower cost is not an improvement when it violates a mandatory data-protection or recovery constraint.

questions.original_stem: Which option is likely to be incorrect in an exam question on this topic?
questions.stem: Which practice provides useful evidence that an operational recovery runbook works?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Exercise the runbook in an isolated recovery test, measure results, and update it from observed failures.
questions.technical_resolution: A tested procedure exposes missing dependencies, permissions, and timing assumptions. Runbooks and observability support learning and repeatable operations.

questions.original_stem: Which review approach improves your accuracy in this module?
questions.stem: A team migrates a workload to managed services. Which architectural conclusion follows the shared responsibility model?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: AWS manages more infrastructure, but the team must still design appropriate access, data protection, configuration, and application behavior.
questions.technical_resolution: The responsibility boundary depends on the service. Managed infrastructure does not remove customer responsibility for data use, permissions, and workload configuration.

questions.topic: Survive loss of a web AZ
questions.original_stem: A scenario requires a sound decision about real-world scenarios. Which approach best meets the requirements?
questions.stem: A web tier runs in one AZ, while its database already has suitable Multi-AZ protection. The business requires the web tier to survive an AZ outage. Which change addresses the missing protection?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Deploy replaceable web instances across multiple AZs behind a multi-AZ ALB and keep required state outside individual instances.
questions.technical_resolution: The unprotected component is the web tier. Database redundancy does not make single-AZ application compute available during that AZ failure.

questions.original_stem: Which choice reduces operational risk in this domain?
questions.stem: Inventory and invoicing must each receive every accepted order, even if one subsystem is temporarily unavailable. Which design isolates their processing backlogs?
questions.correction: Replaced ambiguous or underspecified wording with explicit constraints; reviewed all four alternatives; provided a keyed rationale and a separate reason for every distractor.
questions.reviewed_answer_text: Publish to SNS and subscribe a separate SQS queue for each subsystem, with retry-safe consumers.
questions.technical_resolution: Separate subscribed queues provide independent buffering. Successful publication, correct subscription policies, retry behavior, and idempotent consumers are necessary parts of the design.

questions.topic: Private origin for a public CDN
